naslov.en: The list of the fifth class.

lede.sr: Rad na prototipovima se nastavlja. Na spisku stoji 29 zapisa; 26 radova je fotografisano i objavljeno sa 81 fotografija. Ispod spiska su kadrovi bez imena i zapisi čije fotografije tek stižu — studenti neka se jave za ispravku.
lede.en: The prototype work continues. The list carries 29 entries; 26 works were photographed and published with 81 photographs. Below the list are unnamed frames and entries whose photographs are still to come — students, please get in touch with corrections.

description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak petog časa (30.10.2026), zapisivan redom vođenja; broj uz zapis je broj fotografija. Fotografije: telefon nastavnika, 11:44–14:08. Nastavnik je naveo da na kraju spiska verovatno nedostaje jedan zapis.
description.en: The teacher’s list of the fifth class (30 October 2026), recorded in the order it was kept; the number beside an entry is its photograph count. Photographs: the teacher’s phone, 11:44–14:08. The teacher noted that one entry is probably missing near the end of the list.

napomena.sr: Brojevi su brojevi fotografija, ne ocene. Zapisi bez objavljenih fotografija stoje niže, u delu „Šta se čeka”.
napomena.en: The numbers count photographs, not grades. Entries without published photographs stand below, in the „What we wait for” part.

presek.sr: Niz od 86 kadrova sa telefona podeljen je redom nastavnikovog spiska. Kadrovi 82–84 (jedan rad, kartice sa tačkama) nemaju zapis na spisku; kadrovi 85–86 su grupni snimci u udruženju. Ivin i Andrejev kadar snimljeni su posle udruženja i tek se prenose.
presek.en: The sequence of 86 phone frames was cut in the order of the teacher’s list. Frames 82–84 (one work, cards with dots) have no entry on the list; frames 85–86 are group shots at the association. Iva’s and Andrej’s frames were taken after the association and are still being transferred.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Spisak beleži četiri fotografije iz udruženja; u nizu su nađene dve (kadrovi 85–86), ostale se traže.
analizaUdruzenja.en: The list records four association photographs; two were found in the sequence (frames 85–86), the rest are being looked for.

sta.sr: Ko je autor rada sa kadrova 82–84 (kartice sa tačkama na tabli)? Na spisku za njega nema zapisa. Raspored kraja niza (Natalija 74–75, Dunja 76–78, Marija 79–81) sledi spisak; ko vidi grešku, neka se javi.
sta.en: Who made the work in frames 82–84 (cards with dots on a board)? The list has no entry for it. The end of the sequence (Natalija 74–75, Dunja 76–78, Marija 79–81) follows the list; anyone who sees a mistake, please get in touch.

sta.sr: Potvrđeni su važeći oblici imena zapisa 1 i 3 ovog spiska; isti oblici sada stoje i u spiskovima trećeg i četvrtog časa. Zapis 17 ovog spiska i zapis 30 trećeg časa su isti student: ime je ispravljeno, a indeks dopunjen.
sta.en: The valid name forms of entries 1 and 3 of this list are confirmed; the same forms now stand in the third- and fourth-class lists. Entry 17 of this list and entry 30 of the third class are the same student: the name is corrected and the student number added.
